nodes.applies_when: Entry for Search and Create/Update/End Date/Zap. End Date first validates its separate source/LDG/start/end inputs; missing inputs yield needs_input before GETs. Apply only the requirements for the selected phase; discover display-name identities before enforcing HDL-only fields
Apply only the search date and costing-state defaults before search. Do not require or default any HDL field during Search
Run only resolve_ldg_for_payment_source_search when an LDG filter needs resolution. If no LDG filter is supplied, record skipped; zero or ambiguous LDGs yield needs_selection
Run only search_payment_sources after resolved or skipped LDG lookup; retain the full response for selection

Apply Lookup Execution Rules to the returned collection. A complete plain Search list, including an empty list, returns search_complete. An unresolved operation/code request, partial collection or single-record ambiguity returns needs_selection. A unique selection for Create/Update returns hdl_selected; for End Date return end_date_selected; for a new Zap return zap_selected; for an explicitly requested CostInfo-only recovery with saved accepted-run evidence return recovery_selected; for explicitly requested method-code enrichment of Search, return code_selected. Neither outcome asserts HDL readiness

Run resolve_organization_payment_method_code for the uniquely selected source and apply the common automatic parent-binding gate. Valid relationship evidence returns resolved_hdl for Create/Update, resolved_zap for full Zap, resolved_end_date for End Date, otherwise resolved_search. Missing/ambiguous relationship evidence, explicit conflicts, transport or contract failures return failed; never request parent-association confirmation

Validate only Zap identity and selector inputs, including method binding after discovery for a new full Zap; recovery instead requires saved accepted-run identity and the PM CostInfo-Only Recovery contract; skip all Create/Update flag and account-value groups

Apply PM CostInfo-Only Recovery when that branch is selected; otherwise run query_payment_source_costing_history for the bound PM source and exact selector; retain the complete selected logical history

Apply PM CostInfo-Only Recovery for saved scope and current detail reconciliation when that branch is selected; otherwise run query_payment_source_costing_details across all selected history starts and any exclusivity checks; require aligned CostInfo and complete accounts

For Create apply its HDL input requirements; for Update apply Update scope's delta-first checks without demanding derived end dates or complete user-supplied accounts. Preserve normalized requested flags and reject conflicting role/proportion inputs. Require current automatic parent binding; no reference attachments
Apply only Zap evidence and DAT shape checks to the three-component DELETE plan or reconciled CostInfo-only recovery plan; preparation is not permission to submit
Run resolve_payment_source_update_state for Update before full-input validation and defaults. Create records skipped without a history/detail call. Search and Zap never enter this node

For Update apply resulting-state, date alignment, PM identity, effective flag and required-account checks using live evidence; retain component deltas for runtime mapping. For Create apply its full input and required-account checks unchanged after the state node records skipped. Do not treat a partial business delta as an incomplete full-account input

Apply End Date required selectors, distinct date roles, PM HDL identity and automatic parent binding; no account or flag input. Missing source base code is a business-key gap, never a display-name substitution

Assign Standard Defaults after complete state validation and before Full Flexfield lookups. Create retains its date default; Update consumes its resolved end date and complete account order. Apply role, fixed Proportion and consecutive sequence defaults without user confirmation; reject conflicts
Run resolve_payment_source_kff_ldg for every Create/Update account snapshot, including unchanged Update rows. Skip only for a proven empty Update set permitted by effective flags

Run resolve_payment_source_full_kff, map Update's stored full accounts and component deltas under Full Flexfield Contract, and preserve all unedited values. Skip only when the prior node skipped a proven empty Update set

Run validate_payment_source_full_kff_values for the complete resulting account set, including Update carry-forward rows; retain validated_full_kff_accounts. Skip only for a proven empty Update set. Invalid old/new values or incomplete evidence blocks preparation
Run resolve_payment_source_end_date_state for exact-start, complete-history and aligned CostInfo/account evidence. No Update delta, DELETE target construction or KFF validation

After inputs/defaults, resulting payment-account presence and applicable Full Flexfield checks pass. Update requires its live baseline and validation of all rendered carry-forward accounts; only a proven permitted empty account set skips KFF. Evaluate only the declared dependencies within task scope

Evaluate only Zap dependencies and the shared immutable-archive requirement. Complete source/schema and Task Hook preparation before the final loader approval; skip Create/Update account-write dependencies
Apply End Date state and date-only input checks against the sealed last interval and aligned CostInfo, not Update's new-split rule

Apply ReplaceLastEffectiveEndDate=Y to both members of the same archive when a change is needed. Preserve S/F; CostInfoV3 carries the four observed flags, never defaults them. Skip account and Create/Update date defaults

Evaluate End Date identity, baseline and both components' loader/date-effectivity support for one combined archive. For F=E skip template/capability/upload. No prior CostInfo-only load or intermediate date difference is required

Enforce the selected HDL route. Update requires the complete validated snapshot and exact delta; if all resulting business values equal the baseline, return no_change without an archive. Otherwise continue through preparation and freshness to the single loader approval gate

Apply only Zap policies: three explicit components for full Zap, or only the reconciled failed CostInfo targets for recovery, full logical history, preserved source/method, validated loader route and immutable preview; approval occurs once at the loader gate after refresh

For CostInfo-only recovery, repeat its source/history/detail reconciliation and compare the recovery baseline; otherwise apply Freshness using the history/detail resolvers against the immutable archive baseline before fresh destructive approval; changes require new preparation

Apply Update freshness through the declared source/parent and resolve_payment_source_update_state lookups during preparation, before approval. Changed state blocks the archive; approval resume restores this completed evidence without rerunning GETs

Enforce the combined End Date archive and both component capabilities; F=E returns verified no change. Otherwise proceed to freshness and the single loader gate for CostInfoV3 and CostAllocationV3 together
Apply End Date freshness through the source/parent and resolve_payment_source_end_date_state contracts before preview. Restore this completed evidence on intact approval resume without new GETs
A Create archive passed validation and has fresh approval for core.data-loader handoff.

Apply the Zap preparation and resume gates in ora_design_enforcement.md. For validation-only intent, return validated_only with no upload. For requested execution, require the persisted preflight and Task Hook preview before awaiting_approval; this expected wait is not a failure. A later contextual approval resumes this node with the saved preapproval evidence, verifies the approved artifacts without repeating live checks, hands off once through core.data-loader and returns initiated only after acceptance. Missing or mismatched control artifacts yield blocked, never another execution route

Complete core.data-loader validation of one immutable ZIP containing CostInfoV3.dat and CostAllocationV3.dat, persisted preflight and Task Hook preview with unchanged live flags. Validation-only stops; execution awaits one exact-archive approval. Resume intact controls without GETs/rebuilds, approve/verify envelope and submit both members together once

Finish DAT/source/schema validation and immutable ZIP preparation. For execution, require the persisted loader preflight and Task Hook preview before awaiting approval; resume that gate with intact controls and exact-byte approval verification, then submit once through core.data-loader. Validation-only returns validated_only without upload or approval prompt. Restore completed preapproval evidence on resume, never rebuild or repeat GETs

Return pending on accepted initiation. Resume the same accepted run only on explicit status/verification request, restoring gate evidence; never revisit the submit gate or resubmit. All included component/row results must succeed before terminal_succeeded
Apply PM Zap Verification only after terminal success of every included loader component; use saved source and history, never require the deleted record to resolve

Return pending after accepted initiation; resume the same run only on explicit status/verification request. Require all submitted objects and rows to succeed before verification, never revisit the upload gate

Apply PM Update State and Verification using resolve_payment_source_update_state after all submitted rows succeed on an explicit follow-up. Compare both sides of the new date boundary and preserve earlier/later history; no automatic import retry

Accepted initiation returns pending. Explicit status uses the same core.data-loader run and all error checks; require both CostInfoV3 and CostAllocationV3 rows to succeed before final read-back. Partial or unknown outcomes stop without replay or a separate-object continuation
After both included objects reach terminal success on explicit verification, apply final PM End Date State and Verification with the saved baseline, inclusive end, next day and all earlier values
The approved Create archive is ready for core.data-loader handoff.
The approved Zap was initiated or remains pending; return the exact saved handoff reference. Resume only at CPS.ZAP.RESULT on explicit status/verification request, never at the submit gate
All included loader objects succeeded and PM Zap Verification passed for the complete approved costing scope; preserve source/method and disclose the CostInfo verification boundary

The full-Zap or CostInfo-only recovery artifact, preflight and Task Hook preview are complete. Return the loader approval-required report. Resume CPS.ZAP.GATE only on contextual approval of that exact load; do not repeat preapproval GETs or ask for a second confirmation when the artifacts and context remain intact

Only preparation/validation was requested and completed. Return the loader validation report and requested artifacts with no approval prompt or upload. A later request to execute requires the loader preflight and approval workflow; do not treat this terminal as a prepared submission
Both objects in the combined load succeeded and final End Date checks passed: aligned S..F, next-day absence, original physical accounts and unchanged earlier history/flags

Return the combined load's accepted/pending report. Resume only on explicit status/verification at CPS.END_DATE.RESULT with its saved baseline and IDs; no automatic polling, replay or separate-object submission
Preparation and loader validation of the combined archive finished without a write or approval prompt. A later execution request requires persisted preflight and the exact archive's approval workflow

Return the combined CostInfoV3/CostAllocationV3 preview and its single loader approval requirement. Approval restores CPS.END_DATE.GATE only for those exact bytes and context; no separate-object approval
Complete live state proves the selected last CostInfo/CostAllocation slice already ends on F. Return no change and no import; no template/capability gate or approval is needed
The Update is complete: all submitted components succeeded and the requested new split, changed values and preserved scope passed read-back. This terminal no longer means merely ready to submit
Search needs its minimum source-name fragment or LDG, or Zap needs its start-date selector. Retain supplied inputs and ask only for the missing value; no lookup has run
LDG lookup needs refinement or explicit candidate selection; preserve the returned names and search context
Source lookup needs refinement/selection, is incomplete, or cannot resolve the target of a requested operation or method-code request
Return a complete plain Search/list result, including zero matches, or one selected search row. No HDL execution or approval is implied
Return the source with its resolved organization-method code and association provenance for an explicitly code-enriched Search; no HDL validation, archive or approval
Return the accepted Update Content ID/Request ID and pending result. Resume only on an explicit status/verification request at CPS.UPDATE.RESULT; do not poll automatically or resubmit
Requested preparation/validation completed without a Fusion write. A later execution request still requires loader preflight and exact-artifact approval
Return the immutable Update preview and single loader approval requirement. Contextual approval resumes the saved gate without rebuilding; no second pillar approval
The live validated resulting accounts and flags equal current values. Report no change and no import; no effective split was created
Any search contract/transport, validation, dependency, design, approval, loader, artifact, or unsupported-operation failure. Apply only the diagnosis for the current phase
The request stopped with a classified diagnostic and safe next action.
